about: Hand reading of every validator flag in qwen2.5-7b-instruct.jsonl, by the eval's author, for the validator with the ranking-claim rule (2026-09-26). The review of the earlier validator's flags on the same answers is in git history (commit 2e5af13). This is a judgement, not produced by code; tests/test_eval_scoring.py only checks that it covers exactly the flagged records.
